semantic_correction.stem: After administering a vaccine covered by federal Vaccine Information Statement requirements, which documentation set is required?

options.A: Record the VIS edition and provision dates, vaccinator name/title and office address, administration date, manufacturer, and lot number.
options.B: Record the vaccine brand and next appointment date, but the VIS edition and lot number may be omitted.
options.C: Record the client identifier and injection site, but leave out the vaccinator information and VIS dates.
options.D: Record the manufacturer and lot number, but the administration date and VIS information are unnecessary.

semantic_correction.rationale: CDC's current VIS instructions state that providers must record the VIS edition date and the date the VIS was provided. These requirements supplement federal vaccine-administration recordkeeping that includes the name, address, and title of the individual who administered the vaccine, the date of administration, and the vaccine manufacturer and lot number. CDC's current About VISs page presents the same required elements, specifying the office address together with the name and title of the person who administers the vaccine. Therefore option A contains the required federal documentation set.
semantic_correction.educational_objective: Document the federally required VIS and vaccine-administration information for vaccines covered by the National Childhood Vaccine Injury Act.

audit_findings_append.source_locator: About VISs — Other provider responsibilities; Required Use Instructions — Record information for each VIS provided
audit_findings_append.finding: The revised item tests the complete federal VIS/vaccine recordkeeping set with balanced alternatives and no absolute-word cueing.

option_audit.A: Correct. It includes each required VIS and vaccine-administration recordkeeping element listed by CDC.
option_audit.B: Incorrect. VIS edition/date and lot number are required elements for covered vaccines.
option_audit.C: Incorrect. Client identifiers and injection site do not substitute for the required vaccinator and VIS documentation.
option_audit.D: Incorrect. Administration date and VIS information are required in addition to manufacturer and lot number.

ambiguity_check: No second defensible answer. A alone contains the complete required federal documentation set reflected in current CDC guidance.
cueing_check: All four options are vaccine-documentation sets of comparable length and specificity; no repeated absolute-word or unique-length cue identifies A.
